# FiberTools, Complete Site Documentation

> https://fibertools.app

FiberTools is a suite of 34 free, browser-based calculators and references for fiber arts, knitting, crochet, weaving, spinning, embroidery, cross stitch, and sewing. It is maintained by the maker identified on the About page; no professional fiber-arts credential is claimed. Core calculator arithmetic runs in the browser. Optional network features, including pattern recommendations, newsletter signup, and paid services, use separately disclosed workflows and may send the filters or details needed for that feature. No login is required for self-service calculators, and many core tools work offline as part of the Progressive Web App. All self-service calculators stay free. Optional professional reviews and project downloads are paid.

US crochet terminology is used throughout. Yarn weights follow the Craft Yarn Council (CYC) standard: Lace (0), Fingering (1), Sport (2), DK (3), Worsted (4), Bulky (5), Super Bulky (6), Jumbo (7).

---

## Tools, Knitting & Crochet (25 tools)

### Yarn Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/yarn-calculator
- Scale yarn measured in a representative flat swatch to a rectangular target, add an explicit planning allowance, and convert the result to whole skeins from the yarn label.

### Needle & Hook Size Converter
- URL: https://fibertools.app/needle-converter
- Convert knitting needle and crochet hook sizes between US, UK, metric (mm), and Japanese sizing systems. Includes steel crochet hooks and Tunisian hooks. Bidirectional lookup.

### Gauge Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/gauge-calculator
- Calculate gauge from a swatch and perform bounded stitch- and row-count arithmetic when all required values are supplied. The result does not guarantee fit.

### Yarn Weight Chart
- URL: https://fibertools.app/yarn-weight-chart
- Interactive yarn weight reference chart covering all CYC categories (Lace 0 through Jumbo 7) with US, UK, and Australian names, recommended needle/hook sizes, typical gauge ranges, and substitution compatibility checker.

### Stitch Counter
- URL: https://fibertools.app/stitch-counter
- Track up to six named counts. Reminders are checked at one exact count on the first counter, and browser-local saving is attempted but not guaranteed.

### Blanket Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/blanket-calculator
- Plan stitch count, row count, and yarn needs for listed sizes from receiving (30x30 in) through king (108x100 in), or use custom dimensions. Yarn estimates use the target dimensions together with stitch and row gauge and the yarn consumed by a measured swatch; verify the result against the pattern, yarn label, and a representative swatch.

### Increase & Decrease Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/increase-decrease-calculator
- Build a bounded one-row or one-round stitch plan for distributing an entered increase or decrease. Unsupported or unsafe counts are declined.

### Stripe Generator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/stripe-generator
- Generate a bounded random, weighted, or repeating stripe-row sequence from entered colors and row limits. The tool does not calculate yarn yardage.

### Abbreviation Glossary
- URL: https://fibertools.app/abbreviation-glossary
- Searchable glossary of 200+ knitting and crochet abbreviations with US/UK terminology toggle. Includes definitions, usage notes, and common variations.

### Stitch Pattern Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/stitch-pattern-calculator
- Find bounded whole totals satisfying up to eight entered multiple-plus constraints, optional per-side edges, and a manual or gauge-derived range. Arithmetic compatibility does not validate a pattern or construction.

### Stitch Quick Reference
- URL: https://fibertools.app/stitch-quick-reference
- Visual steps for the crochet and knitting stitches included in the reference.

### UK to US Converter
- URL: https://fibertools.app/uk-to-us-converter
- Replace supported modern UK and US crochet terms in pasted text using a one-pass mapping. Numbers, punctuation, and all unmapped text are left unchanged; the tool does not validate a complete pattern.

### Crochet Circle Round Planner
- URL: https://fibertools.app/circle-calculator
- Generate a basic staggered-increase schedule from an entered starting count and round limit. Swatch and adjust for the material, stitch, and construction; the tool cannot guarantee a flat or round result.

### Sewing & Craft Needle Guide
- URL: https://fibertools.app/needle-guide
- Visual guide to needle types for sewing, embroidery, tapestry, quilting, and other crafts. Includes size ranges, point types, and project recommendations.

### Amigurumi Shapes Guide
- URL: https://fibertools.app/amigurumi-shapes
- Generate bounded arithmetic schedules for the included sphere, cone, cylinder, and oval starting shapes. Verify the technique, literal count, and suitability before use.

### Project Cost Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/project-cost-calculator
- Total entered yarn, notions, patterns, and other extras. Optionally estimate stitching time from an entered stitch count and rate, then compare an entered selling price without treating the result as net profit or a price recommendation.

### Color Pooling Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/color-pooling-calculator
- Preview how an entered repeating color-run sequence maps across a chosen stitch count. It does not solve for an argyle or plaid result; swatching is required.

### WPI to Yarn Weight Converter
- URL: https://fibertools.app/wpi-calculator
- Enter wraps per inch (WPI) to identify yarn weight category, recommended needle/hook sizes, typical gauge range, and suitable project ideas. Essential for unlabeled or handspun yarn.

### Cast On Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/cast-on-calculator
- Calculate a rounded cast-on count from entered width and gauge, with optional pattern-multiple and edge-stitch adjustments.

### Hat Size Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/hat-calculator
- Calculate a rounded cast-on count and bounded eight-section crown schedule from entered head measurement, ease, and gauge. Verify fit and technique with the pattern and a swatch.

### Sock Circumference Stitch Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/sock-calculator
- Calculate one bounded circular stitch-count checkpoint from entered foot circumference, ease, measured gauge, and stitch multiple. It does not infer cuff, heel, gusset, toe, foot length, or pull-on fit.

### Sleeve Shaping Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/sleeve-calculator
- Plan a bounded paired-decrease sleeve taper from entered upper-arm, wrist, length, cuff, and gauge values. The calculator declines odd stitch gaps and schedules denser than one event per shaping row.

### Raglan Body Stitch Checkpoint
- URL: https://fibertools.app/raglan-calculator
- Calculate one bounded finished-body stitch checkpoint from entered circumference, measured gauge, and stitch multiple. It does not infer a neckline, section distribution, yoke schedule, underarm split, or fit.

### Blocking Dimension Change Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/blocking-calculator
- Calculate the signed percentage change between current and requested width or length. The tool does not choose a finishing method or predict what the fabric will achieve.

### Yarn Stash Estimator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/stash-estimator
- Estimate remaining yardage in partial skeins by weighing them. Includes a yardage reference table for identifying unlabeled yarn by weight category.

## Tools, Crochet-Specific (2 tools)

### C2C Blanket Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/c2c-calculator
- Round entered dimensions to a bounded nominal C2C grid from a two-axis swatch, with optional measured yarn-per-block planning arithmetic. Nearest-block rounding and the optional allowance do not guarantee finished size or purchase quantity.

### Granny Square Planner
- URL: https://fibertools.app/granny-square-planner
- Plan a nominal grid, total square count, equal-share color average, and unique internal seam length from entered blanket and square dimensions.

## Tools, Spinning (1 tool)

### Spinning Wheel Drive Ratio Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/spinning-ratio-calculator
- Calculate the ideal geometric ratio between a drive wheel and the pulley connected by its drive band. Use the wheel manual to identify the driven component; no yarn-weight, twist, or plying result is inferred.

## Tools, Weaving (1 tool)

### Weaving Sett Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/weaving-sett-calculator
- Compare a yarn/structure lookup with entered project dimensions, warp allowances, and a supplied reed. Treat the result as a starting point and verify it with a sample.

## Tools, Cross Stitch (1 tool)

### Cross Stitch Calculator
- URL: https://fibertools.app/cross-stitch-calculator
- Calculate dimensions for entered stitch counts and supported fabric counts, with a planning estimate for stranded-cotton use. The thread result is not exact.

## Tools, Embroidery (1 tool)

### Thread Converter
- URL: https://fibertools.app/thread-converter
- Look up exact entries in the included DMC, Anchor, and Cosmo embroidery-thread table. The tool does not include Sulky or infer nearest colors.

---

## Guides

- [How to Read a Yarn Label](https://fibertools.app/guides/reading-yarn-labels): Complete guide to yarn weight symbols, care instructions, dye lots, and gauge information on yarn labels.
- [Knitting Gauge: Why It Matters](https://fibertools.app/guides/knitting-gauge-guide): How to make a gauge swatch, block it, measure it, and resize patterns when your gauge doesn't match.
- [How Much Yarn for a Blanket?](https://fibertools.app/guides/blanket-yarn-guide): Yardage estimates by blanket size and yarn weight, from baby blankets to king-size bedspreads.
- [Knitting Needle Sizes Explained](https://fibertools.app/guides/needle-sizes-guide): US, UK, and metric needle sizing systems explained, plus how to identify unlabeled needles.
- [UK vs US Crochet Terms](https://fibertools.app/guides/uk-us-crochet-terms-guide): Complete conversion guide between UK and US crochet terminology with full chart.
- [What is WPI and How to Measure It](https://fibertools.app/guides/wpi-guide): How wraps per inch works, how to measure it, and WPI ranges for every yarn weight category.
- [How to Price Handmade Knitting and Crochet](https://fibertools.app/guides/pricing-handmade-guide): Calculate the real cost of handmade items including materials, time, and pricing for commissions.
- [Beginner's Guide to Amigurumi](https://fibertools.app/guides/amigurumi-beginners-guide): Shapes, sizes, and math for crochet amigurumi including magic ring, increases, and connecting parts.

## Key Facts
- 34 free self-service tools across fiber arts disciplines
- Core calculator arithmetic stays in the browser; optional network features have separate data flows
- No login or email gate for self-service calculators
- Optional professional reviews and project downloads are paid
- Works offline as a Progressive Web App (PWA)
- Mobile-first responsive design
- US crochet terminology standard
- CYC yarn weight classification (Lace 0 through Jumbo 7)
- Last updated: August 2026
